videos.title: Bloomberg Next Africa
videos.description: A monthly deep dive into Africa's biggest stories through a Bloomberg lens. Global investors see the continent as one of the top areas for opportunity and growth, and some African nations are well-positioned to be global hubs for development. This show will discuss key steps taken to help deliver on Africa's quest of bridging the gap with global powers, and track capital flows and the direction of funds amid the underlying political, economic and social developments.

videos.title: Bloomberg Investigates
videos.description: On Nov. 26, 2025, Hong Kong firefighters were called to Wang Fuk Court, a complex of eight 31-story residential towers; what followed was the city's deadliest fire in almost eight decades that claimed 168 lives and triggered a year of recriminations over who was at fault; examining the ignored warnings and missed opportunities that preceded this disaster, one that continues to impact the families of the dead and the fire's survivors to this day.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg The Asia Trade
videos.description: Bringing global investors everything you need to know as the trading day begins in Asia; Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping markets, from tech, to geopolitics, and the world's energy transition.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg: The China Show
videos.description: Your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy; from politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

videos.title: Live: Insight With Haslinda Amin
videos.description: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change,

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
videos.description: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa; linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
videos.description: From London, essential morning viewing to stay ahead of the day's market trends with news stories from the U.S. and Asia in the lead-up to the opening of European markets.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
videos.description: "The Opening Trade" explores things to know as markets open across Europe; analysis that isn't available anywhere else, a break-down of the biggest stories of the day and top guests who have skin in the game.

videos.title: Live: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
videos.description: "The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics; based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Brief
videos.description: "Bloomberg Brief" delivers the market news, data and analysis viewers need to set their agendas.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Surveillance
videos.description: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance"; their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics; no other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Open Interest
videos.description: Delivering the market-moving news anyone needs to know to get a jump start on the U.S. trading day.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Tech
videos.description: Bloomberg Tech is the only daily live technology program with a focus on breaking news, market-moving reporting and analysis of global technology companies and stories. The program brings the audience interviews from the biggest names in the business, offering in-depth analysis and critical insights.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg ETF IQ
videos.description: Bloomberg ETF IQ focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry; Katie Greifeld, Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas are joined by leaders in this market.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg: Balance of Power
videos.description: "Bloomberg Balance of Power" with host David Westin is a daily look at how politics is impacting global business decisions; top lawmakers, business executives and government leaders join to discuss doing business in today's volatile political climate.

videos.title: Live: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
